messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam@acmeai.com>
To: karthik@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Requesting evaluation credits for new team trial

Hi Karthik / Redwood team,

We just signed up (self-serve) this morning for a Proof-of-Concept using Redwood hosted inference. The account email is trial@acmeai.com. We're a small ML team building an in-product summarization feature for a healthcare analytics pilot and want to validate latency and cost before committing to Dedicated.

Quick details:
- Expected eval duration: 3 weeks
- Estimated token volume: ~1.2M tokens total (mostly generation)
- Primary region: us-west

Is there a standard trial credit allowance we could request to accelerate testing? If helpful, I can share a short one-page scope and a contact for procurement.

Appreciate any guidance — hoping to run end-to-end tests this week.

Thanks,
Liam O'Connor
Head of ML, AcmeAI
liam@acmeai.com

[Attachment: acme_trial_request_form.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: karthik@redwood.com (Karthik Iyer)
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@acmeai.com>
Cc: marissa@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 09:39:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Requesting evaluation credits for new team trial

Hi Liam — welcome and thanks for signing up. Quick answers: we commonly issue short evaluation credits for PLG signups to run realistic tests. A couple quick asks so I can triage this to ops:

1) Can you confirm the HubSpot company record or provide the account email (you listed trial@acmeai.com — is that the primary account)?
2) Do you expect any PII or PHI to be sent to the hosted service? (If yes, we'll need to route for security review.)
3) Rough monthly spend if this scales to production beyond the eval (ballpark helps us size the offer).

If everything is non-PII and this is a short 3-week eval, we typically approve a one-time credit between $2k-$5k worth depending on volume. I'll loop in Dev in Sales Ops to issue the code and Marissa for onboarding notes.

Can you reply here with answers and a preferred Slack/email contact?

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com
Direct: +1 (415) 555-0192

From: dev_patel@redwood.com (Dev Patel)
To: karthik@redwood.com, Liam O'Connor <liam@acmeai.com>
Cc: marissa@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 11:07:00 -0700

Thanks Karthik — I reviewed the inbound form (attached) and the trial account. Liam — thanks for the extra context. Two quick confirmations before I issue a promo code:

- Confirmed: account email = trial@acmeai.com
- Confirmed: no PHI/PII will be sent during the eval (Liam replied: no PHI)
- Estimated token volume: 1.2M (as stated)

Given the expected usage and short eval window, approved for $3,000 in hosted credits. I generated a single-use promo code and uploaded the issuance stub to Drive. The code will auto-apply to the account email (trial@acmeai.com) once applied by the user in Billing -> Credits.

Promo code: ACME-REDWOOD-3K-2027
Expires: 2027-06-15

Attachment: credit-issuance-stub.txt (text/plain) — contains the code and issuance timestamp.

Next steps: Liam, please confirm you see the code applied in billing and ping Marissa for a 30-minute onboarding sync if you'd like assistance with batching and caching settings for lower latency.

Thanks,
Dev Patel

dev_patel@redwood.com
